item.title: Council publishes the consultation responses in full
item.description: The council has published all 2,140 consultation responses in full, alongside a summary of the objections it received. Officers said the summary was prepared before the deadline and that a revised version will follow once late submissions are logged.

item.title: Ferry timetable changes take effect on 1 September
item.description: The operator says the revised ferry timetable takes effect on 1 September, with two additional evening sailings on weekdays and one fewer on Sunday afternoons. Fares are unchanged. The full timetable is on the operator's website.
